description:
Workspace.dependencies declares serde, serde_json, thiserror, tokio (and 6 more) as canonical version pins. Only 2 crates inherit from it:
- crate-jmap-mime/Cargo.toml — uses `mime-tree = { workspace = true }` and `serde_json = { workspace = true }`
- crate-jmap-mail-server/Cargo.toml — dev-dep `mime-tree = { workspace = true }`

Every other crate redeclares `serde`, `serde_json`, `thiserror`, `tokio` with fresh version strings and feature lists. This means the workspace.dependencies table is non-authoritative; it serves only as documentation that doesn't match reality.

Fix: convert all per-crate dep entries to `{ workspace = true }` references. Specifically for:
- serde
- serde_json
- thiserror (where used)
- tokio
- http
- url (jmap-base-client)
- futures (jmap-base-client)
- reqwest (jmap-base-client)
- tokio-tungstenite (jmap-base-client)

Tied to JMAP-sc1b.3 (workspace.package inheritance) and JMAP-sc1b.X (reqwest feature mismatch) — fixing them together is one commit.
title: P2: 23 of 25 crates ignore workspace.dependencies for serde, serde_json, thiserror, tokio
